summary: Initializes an encoding-state object: stores the a2 argument at offset 0x0, zeroes offsets 0x8 and 0xC, runs the locale encoding initialization routine sub_59A54D on a2, stores the CRT global dword_8D5A6C into offset 0x10, then runs the locale encoding cleanup routine sub_59A5E9 on a2. Returns the this pointer.

operations.description: Write the a2 argument into the object at byte offset 0x0 (this[0]).
Zero the dword at byte offset 0x8 (this[2]).
Zero the dword at byte offset 0xC (this[3]).
Call sub_59A54D with the address of a2 as argument; locale/encoding initialization step.
Store the CRT global value dword_8D5A6C into byte offset 0x10 (this[4]).
Call sub_59A5E9 with the address of a2 as argument; locale/encoding cleanup or finalization step.
Return the this pointer (object is used as an output).

unresolved: The sub_59A54D and sub_59A5E9 calls take the address of a local copy of a2, not of the stored object field; the object/reference relationship between a2 and the encoding state is unclear.
Roles of dword_5B9CD8 and dword_5B9CDC are not visible in the raw source of this function.
dword_8D5A6C provides the initial value for offset 0x10 but its meaning (e.g. locale id, code page) is unresolved.
